title: George Michael: Freedom - The Film

asr.full_text: He's got a voice like an angel. I won't let you down. He's just got that thing which is unquantifiable. I will not give you up. He's a proper, proper, proper singer. Gotta have some faith in the sound. There's no voice like his on the radio. It's the one good thing that I've got. Yeah. All I remember is Faith being played 50 times a day on MTV. He uniquely achieved recognition on the R&B scene. All I remember is Faith being played 50 times a day on MTV. He uniquely achieved recognition on the R&B soul charts that very few white performers ever got. You mean George is white? After a massive solo like the Faith album was, expectations were hugely high. So everybody wanted a piece of George. He must have felt quite trapped. George is very stubborn. George Michael is today asking a High Court judge to declare his recording contract null and void. I will never know if Sony and I would have ended up in court had Anselmo not become ill. George unquestionably lost the battle but won the war because he got a freedom that he craved for. Well, it changed the whole face of how videos were done because the videos said everything. It was genius. It was like the magic moment. It's the Mona Lisa, like you don't really touch it. George is authentic. He's not mass produced. He's famous. This guy is going to be around a long time.
